grapes.name: Bombino Bianco
grapes.summary: 兼用于静止白酒与起泡酒的丰产品种，也是意大利南部重要的遗传祖先。
grapes.origin: 在 Puglia 及意大利中南部历史悠久，确切起源地未定。
grapes.viticulture: 成熟较晚、产量较高，产量控制与采收时机影响酸度及浓度。
grapes.winemaking: 可单酿、白葡萄混酿及作为起泡酒基酒；风味较中性，酿造方式影响明显。
grapes.taste: 果香通常较内敛、酸度清新、酒体适中，受产量与成熟度影响。
grapes.confusions: Pagadebit／Pagadebiti 为多义地方名称，不可与独立的 Pagadebiti／Rollo 条目合并；Bombino Nero 是其后代，并非颜色突变。

text.en: Long established in Puglia and elsewhere in central-southern Italy; its place of origin remains uncertain.

text.en: Late ripening and generous yields; crop control and harvest timing determine the balance between acidity and dilution.
text.zh: 成熟较晚、产量较高，产量控制与采收时机影响酸度及浓度。

text.en: Used alone and in white blends, including sparkling bases; its neutral character leaves considerable scope for the production method.
text.zh: 可单酿、白葡萄混酿及作为起泡酒基酒；风味较中性，酿造方式影响明显。

text.en: Generally restrained fruit, fresh acidity and moderate body; style varies with yield and ripeness.
text.zh: 果香通常较内敛、酸度清新、酒体适中，受产量与成熟度影响。

text.en: Pagadebit/Pagadebiti is an ambiguous local name: do not merge with the separate Pagadebiti/Rollo record. Bombino Nero is an offspring, not a colour mutation.
text.zh: Pagadebit／Pagadebiti 为多义地方名称，不可与独立的 Pagadebiti／Rollo 条目合并；Bombino Nero 是其后代，并非颜色突变。

grapes.name: Bombino Nero
grapes.summary: Puglia 重要的桃红品种，酸度鲜明，并有独立 Castel del Monte DOCG。
grapes.origin: 历史上集中于 Bari 以北。
grapes.viticulture: 中等长势、结实较多、中晚熟；有翼果穗，果皮较厚。
grapes.winemaking: 以桃红酒见长，也与 Nero di Troia、Montepulciano 混酿红酒。
grapes.taste: 潜在酒精度相对适中，酸度清新；典型应用是果味桃红，并非必然浓厚红酒。
grapes.confusions: 与 Impigno、Uva di Troia 同双亲；并非 Bombino Bianco 的红色突变。

text.zh: 中等长势、结实较多、中晚熟；有翼果穗，果皮较厚。

text.en: Relatively moderate alcohol potential with fresh acidity; fruit-led rosato rather than automatically powerful red wine.
text.zh: 潜在酒精度相对适中，酸度清新；典型应用是果味桃红，并非必然浓厚红酒。

text.en: Full sibling of Impigno and Uva di Troia; not a red mutation of Bombino Bianco.
text.zh: 与 Impigno、Uva di Troia 同双亲；并非 Bombino Bianco 的红色突变。

grapes.name: Impigno
grapes.summary: Ostuni 地区少见白品种，传统上与本地白葡萄混酿。
grapes.origin: 见于 Ostuni、Carovigno、Cisternino、Ceglie Messapica；地方记载称其由昵称 Impigno 的农户从 Martina Franca 带入。
grapes.viticulture: 中早熟、长势较强、喜深厚土壤，倒卵形果粒、薄皮。
grapes.winemaking: 传统用于 Ostuni 白酒，与 Verdeca、Bianco d’Alessano、Francavidda 混酿。
grapes.taste: 白酒风味较中性、干型，酒精与酒体通常不浓重。
grapes.confusions: 与 Bombino Nero、Uva di Troia 同双亲，但果皮为白色。

grapes.name: Bianco d’Alessano
grapes.summary: Valle d’Itria 白品种，传统上在 Locorotondo 与 Martina Franca 与 Verdeca 配合。

grapes.taste: 果香细致，在混酿中增加圆润感。
grapes.confusions: 虽常与 Verdeca 混酿，仍是不同品种。

grapes.summary: Puglia 代表性白葡萄，风格清新、较中性；Pampanuto 属同一注册身份。

grapes.viticulture: 产量较高；酸度与采收成熟度决定清新白酒风格。

grapes.name: Gaglioppo

grapes.winemaking: 用于干红与桃红；萃取须依果皮单宁成熟度调整，陈年可柔化结构。
grapes.taste: 单宁坚实、红果与咸鲜感，具陈年能力；结构强不等于颜色必定深。
grapes.confusions: 与 Magliocco Dolce、Magliocco Canino 不同；与 Nerello Mascalese 同双亲。

text.en: Vigorous and productive, intermediate-late maturity; mildew susceptibility and water stress require management.
text.zh: 长势强、产量高、中晚熟；须管理霜霉病、白粉病及水分胁迫。

text.en: Dry red and rosato production; extraction must suit skin tannin maturity. Maturation can soften its firm structure.
text.zh: 用于干红与桃红；萃取须依果皮单宁成熟度调整，陈年可柔化结构。

text.en: Firm tannin, savoury red-fruit character and ageing capacity; deep colour is not required for substantial structure.
text.zh: 单宁坚实、红果与咸鲜感，具陈年能力；结构强不等于颜色必定深。

text.en: Distinct from Magliocco Dolce and Magliocco Canino. Shares its parents with Nerello Mascalese.
text.zh: 与 Magliocco Dolce、Magliocco Canino 不同；与 Nerello Mascalese 同双亲。

grapes.summary: 经鉴定的 Aeolian 无籽红葡萄，用于 Malvasia delle Lipari，亦有干型单品种装瓶。

grapes.taste: Castellaro 实例表现成熟红果、香料及咸鲜结构，属该生产者酒款描述。

text.en: Old vines survive on the Aeolian Islands. The traditional Greek-origin story does not establish the genetic origin of the authenticated Aeolian material.
text.zh: Aeolian 群岛仍有老株；传统希腊起源故事不能证明经鉴定材料的遗传起源。

text.en: Authenticated Aeolian Corinto Nero is a seedless somatic variant of Sangiovese, not a sexual crossing or Greek Black Corinth.
text.zh: 经鉴定的 Aeolian Corinto Nero 是 Sangiovese 的无籽体细胞变异，并非有性杂交，也不是希腊 Black Corinth。

text.en: Seedlessness reflects a somatic variant. Tenuta di Castellaro’s Lipari example uses bush vines on sandy volcanic soils at 350 m.
text.zh: 无籽特征来自体细胞变异；Tenuta di Castellaro 在 Lipari 的实例位于海拔 350 米砂质火山土、采用灌木藤。

text.en: Compulsory 5–8% component of Malvasia delle Lipari; Castellaro Corinto is a 100% dry red with skin maceration and barrel maturation.
text.zh: Malvasia delle Lipari 须含 5–8%；Castellaro Corinto 为 100% 干红，经浸皮及桶中熟化。

text.en: The Castellaro example shows ripe red fruit, spice and savoury structure; these are producer-specific descriptors.
text.zh: Castellaro 实例表现成熟红果、香料及咸鲜结构，属该生产者酒款描述。

text.en: The Aeolian material studied as Corinto Nero (VIVC 24403) is not Greek Black Corinth. A Librandi collection name once described as erroneous was genetically matched to the Aeolian material in the later study.
text.zh: 研究中的 Aeolian Corinto Nero（VIVC 24403）不是希腊 Black Corinth；较早被视为误名的 Librandi 收藏材料，后续研究确认与 Aeolian 材料同型。

translations.origin: Messina and northeastern Sicily are major references; also cultivated across parts of Calabria.
translations.viticulture: Good vigour, medium ripening; short pruning suits local bush vines. Susceptibility to fungal diseases requires attention.
translations.winemaking: Traditional northeastern Sicilian red blends, varietal reds and documented rosato sparkling wines.
translations.taste: High sugar can coexist with firm acidity; wines can be deeply coloured and substantial.
translations.confusions: Keep authenticated Nocera distinct from Scilla material locally called Nocera but identified as Magliocco Canino.

translations.viticulture: Mid-September maturity; large berries, bush training and short pruning; useful reported fungal-disease tolerance.
translations.winemaking: Usually blended with other local red grapes.

translations.origin: Siracusa is the historic centre, with surviving vines also in Ragusa; described by Nicosia in 1735.

translations.winemaking: Dry white wines and historically sweet or fortified expressions; contemporary skin-contact wines are producer choices.

translations.origin: Recorded around Randazzo, Bronte and Piedimonte; sporadic vines remain on Etna.
translations.viticulture: Long, loose bunches and elongated berries; regional research documents a distinctive anthocyanin profile.
translations.winemaking: Historically fermented in local blends and also dried or stored for eating.

translations.summary: A revived Sicilian red whose agronomic and winemaking potential is being evaluated in regional research vineyards.
translations.origin: Preserved within Sicily’s recovered minor-grape collection and the BI.VI.SI research programme.
translations.viticulture: Regional trials report moderate, fairly regular productivity and medium-low shoot fertility; ripening extends into mid-September.
translations.winemaking: Experimental varietal vinification evaluates colour, phenolic balance and acid retention.
translations.taste: Trial wines show good alcoholic strength and adequate acidity, with modest anthocyanin levels; do not equate total phenolics with colour.
translations.confusions: Use the authenticated Lucignola identity; similarly spelled local names require verification.

translations.origin: Recovered from a small number of old vines in the Nebrodi area; the name is linked locally to brittle, glass-like winter canes.
translations.viticulture: Authenticated material is evaluated across research sites; its historical scarcity does not itself establish disease or drought resistance.
translations.winemaking: Experimental red-wine production within the Sicilian biodiversity programme.
translations.taste: Regional research classifies it as non-aromatic, with norisoprenoid precursors contributing to aroma potential.
translations.confusions: Keep Vitrarolo distinct from other revived Sicilian reds; revival is not a synonym group.

translations.summary: A genetically distinctive white now centred on Goceano, with contrasting historical uses elsewhere on Sardegna.
translations.origin: Historically documented in central Sardegna, especially Goceano, with remnants in Planargia and Oristano.
translations.viticulture: Late maturation and vigorous growth require site-specific canopy and crop management.
translations.winemaking: Historically made in a Malvasia-like manner in Planargia and as younger-drinking white wine in Oristano.
translations.taste: Neutral rather than Muscat-aromatic; production method determines dry or concentrated expression.
translations.confusions: AGRIS found an isolated genetic profile; similarity to Retagliado in a dendrogram is not proof of parentage.

translations.summary: A central-southern Sardinian white particularly associated with Marmilla and Mogoro.
translations.origin: Historical records include Marmilla, Campidano and adjacent districts; its decline was partly associated with replacement by Nuragus.
translations.viticulture: Small compact bunches and low yields are described by Mogoro producers; harvest timing varies with dry or concentrated styles.
translations.winemaking: Dry whites, sparkling and concentrated styles; oak use belongs to the specific producer and wine.
translations.taste: Floral and orchard-fruit expressions with a textured palate; late-picked examples differ from fresh dry wines.
translations.confusions: Not Nuragus. AGRIS reports candidate first-degree relationships, not a complete established pair of parents.
translations.geneticsNote: The consulted identity research does not establish a complete pair of parents.

translations.summary: The white grape behind Oristano’s distinctive mature dry wines, often aged under flor; authenticated material matches Spergola.
translations.origin: Long established in Campidano di Oristano. Genetic research also connects this identity with northern Italian Spergola; an exclusively Sardinian origin is not established.
translations.viticulture: Locally grown in low-lying Tirso/Sinis vineyards; bush and trained vines coexist. Harvest timing is producer- and site-specific.
translations.winemaking: Contini Flor uses soft pressing followed by about four years in partly filled oak and chestnut casks under a yeast veil.
translations.taste: Mature examples are dry, gold to amber, full and almond-scented, with oxidative/biological complexity.
translations.confusions: Not Granatza/Guarnaccia Bianca. Spergola synonymy refers to authenticated registered material; AGRIS warns that one different database accession bears the same name.
translations.geneticsNote: The consulted identity research does not establish a complete pair of parents.

translations.summary: An old Sardinian white used both for wine and table consumption, especially familiar as Retagliadu in Gallura.

translations.viticulture: Late ripening, with large round berries in comparatively loose bunches.
translations.winemaking: Used in local white production and historically as fresh fruit; varietal wines remain a specialised reference.
translations.taste: Not identified as a Muscat-aromatic grape; site and blending govern its final expression.
translations.confusions: AGRIS suggests a possible first-degree relationship with Apesorgia Nera, not a demonstrated complete pedigree.

translations.summary: The authenticated Aeolian seedless red used in Malvasia delle Lipari and also bottled as a dry varietal wine.
translations.origin: Old vines survive on the Aeolian Islands. The traditional Greek-origin story does not establish the genetic origin of the authenticated Aeolian material.
translations.viticulture: Seedlessness reflects a somatic variant. Tenuta di Castellaro’s Lipari example uses bush vines on sandy volcanic soils at 350 m.
translations.winemaking: Compulsory 5–8% component of Malvasia delle Lipari; Castellaro Corinto is a 100% dry red with skin maceration and barrel maturation.
translations.taste: The Castellaro example shows ripe red fruit, spice and savoury structure; these are producer-specific descriptors.
translations.confusions: The Aeolian material studied as Corinto Nero (VIVC 24403) is not Greek Black Corinth. A Librandi collection name once described as erroneous was genetically matched to the Aeolian material in the later study.
translations.geneticsNote: Authenticated Aeolian Corinto Nero is a seedless somatic variant of Sangiovese, not a sexual crossing or Greek Black Corinth.

body.en: Manduria and the surrounding Ionian-facing countryside.
body.zh: Manduria 及其周边面向爱奥尼亚海的乡村。

body.en: The dry/abboccato DOC is separate from Dolce Naturale DOCG.
body.zh: 干型／微甜 DOC 与 Dolce Naturale DOCG 分开。

body.en: Primitivo at least 85%.
body.zh: Primitivo 至少 85%。

body.en: Up to 15% suitable non-aromatic black varieties.
body.zh: 最多 15% 获准非芳香黑葡萄。

body.en: Primitivo is the Italian name of the Zinfandel/Tribidrag genotype.
body.zh: Primitivo 为 Zinfandel／Tribidrag 同型葡萄的意大利名称。

body.en: Emergency irrigation is permitted; forcing is prohibited.
body.zh: 允许应急灌溉，禁止催产。

body.en: Grapes must come from the delimited suitable land, not all of both provinces.
body.zh: 葡萄须来自划定适宜地块，并非两省所有土地。

body.en: High sugar potential requires matching phenolic ripeness to the intended style.
body.zh: 高糖潜力需与目标风格及酚类成熟协调。

body.en: Primitivo di Manduria and Riserva.
body.zh: 普通及 Riserva。

body.en: At least 24 months ageing, including 9 months in wood.
body.zh: 至少 24 个月熟化，其中 9 个月木桶。

body.en: Riserva ageing is calculated from 1 November of the harvest year.
body.zh: Riserva 熟化从采收年 11 月 1 日起算。

body.en: Dry to abboccato; reducing sugar no more than 18 g/L.
body.zh: 干至微甜，糖不高于 18 g/L。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 13.5%; Riserva 14%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精度 13.5%，Riserva 14%。

body.en: Full red wine; permitted sweetness is not the same as the Dolce Naturale category.
body.zh: 饱满红酒，允许的残糖并不等于 Dolce Naturale 类别。

body.zh: Bianco 及 Casignana 的指定部分。

body.en: Ionian coast of the Locride.
body.zh: Locride 的爱奥尼亚海岸。

body.en: Greco Bianco at least 95% in the specification.
body.zh: 规范中的 Greco Bianco 至少 95%。

body.en: The local aromatic grape corresponds to Malvasia di Lipari/Malvasia di Sardegna.
body.zh: 当地芳香葡萄对应 Malvasia di Lipari／Malvasia di Sardegna。

body.en: Up to 5% suitable grapes of analogous colour.
body.zh: 最多 5% 获准同色葡萄。

body.en: Local aromatic Greco di Bianco matures in the second/third ten-day period of August.
body.zh: 地方芳香型 Greco di Bianco 于八月中下旬成熟。

body.en: Large, elongated and loose, with relatively small berries.
body.zh: 果穗长大疏松、果粒相对小。

body.en: Sensitive to cold and drought; powdery mildew and moths require attention.
body.zh: 对寒冷及干旱敏感，注意白粉病与葡萄蛾。

body.en: Grapes dry on racks in the sun or in forced-air drying rooms.
body.zh: 葡萄在日晒架上或强制通风室中干燥。

body.en: Dried grapes are crushed and pressed.
body.zh: 风干后破碎、压榨。

body.en: Passito; drying alone does not imply fortification.
body.zh: 风干甜酒，干燥本身不等于加烈。

body.en: Not before 1 November following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收次年 11 月 1 日。

body.en: Straw yellow with amber reflections.
body.zh: 稻草黄带琥珀色泽。

body.en: Orange blossom, dried figs, candied citrus and honeyed warmth.
body.zh: 橙花、无花果干、糖渍柑橘及蜂蜜般暖润感。

role.en: Local Greco di Bianco identity; legal minimum 95%.
role.zh: 当地 Greco di Bianco 身份，法定最低 95%。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: A delimited volcanic-slope DOC with Carricante whites, Nerello-led reds/rosato and traditional-method sparkling wines.
intro.zh: 火山坡地划定 DOC，涵盖 Carricante 白酒、Nerello 主体红／桃红及传统法起泡酒。

body.en: Etna DOC
body.zh: Etna DOC

body.en: Catania; delimited parts of municipalities around the volcano.
body.zh: Catania 省，环火山市镇的划定部分。

body.en: Grapes must originate in the delimited zone of Milo.
body.zh: 葡萄须来自 Milo 的指定区域。

body.en: The DOC boundary follows commune, altitude and physical landscape lines; not every Etna vineyard is eligible.
body.zh: DOC 边界由市镇、等高线及实际地貌划定，并非 Etna 每块园均获准。

body.en: Volcanic deposits of different ages.
body.zh: 不同年代的火山沉积。

body.en: Lava flows and ash create marked local soil differences.
body.zh: 熔岩流及火山灰造成地块差异。

body.en: Altitude and slope aspect change ripening conditions around the volcano.
body.zh: 海拔与坡向改变火山周围的成熟条件。

body.en: Carricante ≥60%; Catarratto 0–40%; other suitable non-aromatic whites at most 15% of the total.
body.zh: Carricante 至少 60%，Catarratto 0–40%，其他获准非芳香白葡萄不超过总量 15%。

body.en: Carricante ≥80%; other suitable non-aromatic whites up to 20%.
body.zh: Carricante 至少 80%，其他获准非芳香白葡萄最多 20%。

body.en: Nerello Mascalese ≥80%; Nerello Cappuccio 0–20%; permitted white grapes at most 10% overall.
body.zh: Nerello Mascalese 至少 80%，Nerello Cappuccio 0–20%，获准白葡萄最多占总量 10%。

body.en: Nerello Mascalese at least 80%.
body.zh: Nerello Mascalese 至少 80%。

body.en: Bottle fermentation; at least 18 months on lees.
body.zh: 瓶内二次发酵，酒泥陈年至少 18 个月。

body.en: At least four years ageing, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 至少四年陈年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: Carricante supplies pronounced acidity and ageing potential.
body.zh: Carricante 提供鲜明酸度及陈年潜力。

body.en: Nerello Mascalese supplies acidity and tannin; extraction and maturity shape balance.
body.zh: Nerello Mascalese 提供酸度与单宁，萃取及成熟度决定平衡。

body.en: Additional geographical names must correspond to the delimited units in the specification.
body.zh: 附加地理名称须对应规范所划定单位。

role.en: Traditional Etna white in old mixed vineyards; suitable-white complement subject to the DOC rules.
role.zh: Etna 老混种园传统白品种，补充比例须依 DOC 规则。

sources.title: Regione Siciliana · Identità e ricchezza del vigneto Sicilia (2014)

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: A southeastern Sicilian red combining Nero d’Avola structure with Frappato perfume.
intro.zh: Sicilia 东南部红酒，结合 Nero d’Avola 结构与 Frappato 香气。

body.en: Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG
body.zh: Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG

body.en: Recognised as DOC in 1973.
body.zh: 1973 年获 DOC。

body.en: DOCG recognition in 2005.
body.zh: 2005 年获 DOCG。

body.en: Vittoria DOC is a separate denomination.
body.zh: Vittoria DOC 为另一独立产区。

body.en: Southeastern Sicily, centred on Vittoria.
body.zh: Sicilia 东南部，以 Vittoria 为中心。

body.en: Delimited areas in Ragusa, Caltanissetta and Catania.
body.zh: Ragusa、Caltanissetta 与 Catania 的划定地区。

body.en: A delimited historical area with later release.
body.zh: 划定历史区，上市更晚。

body.en: Limestone and calcarenite are important substrates.
body.zh: 石灰岩与钙屑岩为重要基质。

body.en: Sandy and clay-sandy soils occur across the denomination.
body.zh: 产区可见砂土与黏砂土。

body.en: Coastal plains and inland slopes create differences in exposure and water availability.
body.zh: 海岸平地与内陆坡地带来朝向及供水差异。

body.en: Both grapes are compulsory within these ranges.
body.zh: 两品种均须在规定区间内使用。

body.en: Maximum grape-to-wine yield 65%, equivalent to 52 hL/ha at the specified grape yield.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 65%，按规定葡萄产量相当于 52 百升／公顷。

body.en: Not before 1 June of the year following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收次年 6 月 1 日。

body.en: Not before 31 March of the second year following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收后第二年 3 月 31 日。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: An island DOC centred on Zibibbo, covering dry, sweet, sparkling and separately fortified categories.
intro.zh: 以 Zibibbo 为核心的海岛 DOC，涵盖干、甜、起泡及独立加强酒型。

body.en: Pantelleria DOC
body.zh: Pantelleria DOC

body.en: The entire island of Pantelleria, province of Trapani.
body.zh: Trapani 省的整个 Pantelleria 岛。

body.en: Volcanic island, exposed to strong winds.
body.zh: 火山海岛，强风明显。

body.en: Low bush vines in sheltered hollows are adapted to wind exposure.
body.zh: 低矮灌木藤及避风凹地适应强风。

body.en: Zibibbo is Muscat of Alexandria.
body.zh: Zibibbo 即 Muscat of Alexandria。

body.en: Named Moscato/Passito categories require 100% Zibibbo.
body.zh: Moscato／Passito 酒型要求 100% Zibibbo。

body.en: Bianco, including Frizzante, allows up to 15% other suitable Sicilian white grapes.
body.zh: Bianco（含 Frizzante）可用最多 15% 其他 Sicilia 获准白葡萄。

body.en: New specialised plantings at least 2,000 vines/ha.
body.zh: 新设专用园至少 2,000 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum grape yield 10 tonnes/ha for the listed categories.
body.zh: 所列酒型最高葡萄产量 10 吨／公顷。

body.en: Emergency irrigation permitted; forcing prohibited.
body.zh: 允许应急灌溉，禁止催产。

body.en: All or part of the grapes are sun-dried on or off the vine.
body.zh: 全部或部分葡萄藤上或采后日晒风干。

body.en: Passito grape-to-wine maximum 40%.
body.zh: Passito 最高出酒率 40%。

body.en: Moscato Liquoroso and Passito Liquoroso require added grape-derived alcohol; ordinary Passito is a separate category.
body.zh: Moscato Liquoroso 与 Passito Liquoroso 要求添加葡萄来源酒精；普通 Passito 是另一酒型。

body.en: Not before 1 July following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收次年 7 月 1 日。

body.en: Minimum total 20%, of which actual alcohol at least 14%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精 20%，实际至少 14%。

body.en: Vinification, drying and fortification occur on Pantelleria; sparkling operations may occur within Sicily.
body.zh: 酿造、风干、加烈在岛上进行；起泡工序可在 Sicilia 范围内。

role.en: Zibibbo: 100% except Bianco/Frizzante may include ≤15% other suitable whites.
role.zh: Zibibbo：通常 100%，但 Bianco／Frizzante 可含最多 15% 其他获准白葡萄。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: A fortified-wine DOC classified by colour, sweetness and minimum ageing, governed here by the August 2026 consolidated text.
intro.zh: 加强酒 DOC，按颜色、甜度及最低陈年分类；本档案依 2026 年 8 月整合法规。

body.en: Marsala DOC
body.zh: Marsala DOC

body.en: Trapani province, excluding Pantelleria, Favignana and Alcamo.
body.zh: Trapani 省，但排除 Pantelleria、Favignana、Alcamo。

body.en: Operations required to produce the finished Marsala occur in the production zone.
body.zh: 形成成品 Marsala 的加工须在产区内。

body.en: Consolidated specification attached to the decree of 5 August 2026.
body.zh: 依 2026 年 8 月 5 日法令所附整合规范。

body.en: Grillo, Catarratto, Ansonica/Inzolia and Damaschino.
body.zh: Grillo、Catarratto、Ansonica／Inzolia、Damaschino。

body.en: Perricone, Calabrese/Nero d’Avola and Nerello Mascalese.
body.zh: Perricone、Calabrese／Nero d’Avola、Nerello Mascalese。

body.en: Up to 30% of the permitted white grapes.
body.zh: 可含最多 30% 指定白葡萄。

body.en: Maximum 10 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 10 吨／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 9 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 9 吨／公顷。

body.en: Grapes must provide at least 13% natural potential alcohol.
body.zh: 葡萄须具至少 13% 天然潜在酒精。

body.en: Cooked must, concentrated must and sifone are prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止煮汁、浓缩汁及 sifone。

body.en: Fine 1 year; Superiore 2; Superiore Riserva 4; Vergine 5; Vergine Riserva/Stravecchio 10.
body.zh: Fine 1 年；Superiore 2 年；Superiore Riserva 4 年；Vergine 5 年；Vergine Riserva／Stravecchio 10 年。

body.en: Ageing in wood; Fine may spend its first four months in other containers.
body.zh: 木容器陈年；Fine 前四个月可用其他容器。

body.en: Reducing sugars below 40 g/L.
body.zh: 还原糖低于 40 g/L。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 17.5%; other listed categories at least 18%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精 17.5%，其他所列等级至少 18%。

body.en: Ageing starts after completion of concia.
body.zh: 陈年从 concia 配制完成后起算。

coverage.en: Selected documented grapes and denominations; this dossier is not a claim of exhaustive regional coverage.
coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: The Aeolian aromatic wine DOC, combining Malvasia di Lipari with a small but compulsory Corinto Nero component.
intro.zh: Aeolian 群岛芳香酒 DOC，以 Malvasia di Lipari 加少量必需 Corinto Nero。

body.en: Malvasia delle Lipari DOC
body.zh: Malvasia delle Lipari DOC

body.en: Aeolian/Lipari archipelago.
body.zh: Aeolian／Lipari 群岛。

body.en: Messina.
body.zh: Messina。

body.en: DOC established by decree in 1973.
body.zh: 1973 年法令建立 DOC。

body.en: Malvasia di Lipari maximum 95%.
body.zh: Malvasia di Lipari 最高 95%。

body.en: Required at 5–8%.
body.zh: 必须使用 5–8%。

body.en: Malvasia di Lipari is the same genotype as Malvasia di Sardegna.
body.zh: Malvasia di Lipari 与 Malvasia di Sardegna 同型。

body.en: Maximum 9 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 9 吨／公顷。

body.en: Emergency irrigation is allowed.
body.zh: 允许应急灌溉。

body.en: Forcing is prohibited.
body.zh: 禁止催产。

body.en: Bianco, Passito and Liquoroso in the published specification.
body.zh: 已公布规范列 Bianco、Passito、Liquoroso。

body.en: Maximum 45% from grapes to wine.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 45%。

body.en: A separate category made by fortification; it is not a synonym for Passito.
body.zh: 加烈的独立酒型，不是 Passito 同义词。

body.en: Not before 1 June following harvest.
body.zh: 不早于采收次年 6 月 1 日。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 18%; natural residual sugar at least 6%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精 18%，天然残糖至少 6%。

body.en: The published Bianco profile is sweet-aromatic; the discussed 2026 dry/UGA proposal is not treated as enacted in this dossier.
body.zh: 已公布 Bianco 描述为甜且芳香；2026 年讨论的干型／UGA 提案在本档案不作为已生效法规。

coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: A northeastern Sardinian DOCG tied to granitic soils and Vermentino, with still and specialised wine categories.
intro.zh: Sardegna 东北部 DOCG，以花岗岩土壤与 Vermentino 为核心，兼静止及其他酒型。

body.en: Vermentino di Gallura DOCG
body.zh: Vermentino di Gallura DOCG

body.en: DOCG recognised in 1996.
body.zh: 1996 年获 DOCG。

body.en: Northeastern Sardegna.
body.zh: Sardegna 东北部。

body.en: Separate from the broader Vermentino di Sardegna DOC.
body.zh: 与范围更广的 Vermentino di Sardegna DOC 分开。

body.en: Vineyard soils must derive from decomposed granite.
body.zh: 葡萄园土壤须源于花岗岩分解。

body.en: Coarse sand with variable finer clay fractions.
body.zh: 粗砂质，夹不同比例细黏粒。

body.en: Eligible vineyards no higher than 500 m.
body.zh: 获准葡萄园不高于 500 米。

body.en: At least 95%.
Up to 5% other suitable non-aromatic white varieties.
body.zh: 最多 5% 其他获准非芳香白葡萄。

body.en: Still, Superiore, Frizzante, Spumante, Passito and Vendemmia Tardiva.
body.zh: 静止、Superiore、微泡、起泡、风干及晚摘。

body.en: New/replanted vines at least 3,250/ha.
body.zh: 新植／重植至少 3,250 株／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 10 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 10 吨／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 9 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 9 吨／公顷。

body.en: Still 12%; Superiore 13%.
body.zh: 静止 12%，Superiore 13%。

body.en: At least nine months from tirage for traditional-method sparkling wine.
body.zh: 传统法起泡自 tirage 起至少九个月。

body.en: Dry whites have aromatic persistence and freshness; late harvest and passito are distinct categories.
body.zh: 干白香气持久、清新；晚摘与风干为不同酒型。

coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: Island-wide Cannonau DOC with a more restricted Classico zone and three named subzones.
intro.zh: 覆盖全岛的 Cannonau DOC，另设较小 Classico 区及三个子区。

body.en: Cannonau di Sardegna DOC
body.zh: Cannonau di Sardegna DOC

body.en: DOC established in 1972.
body.zh: DOC 建于 1972 年。

body.en: Entire Sardegna region.
body.zh: 整个 Sardegna 大区。

body.en: Nuoro and Ogliastra as delimited in the specification.
body.zh: 规范界定的 Nuoro 与 Ogliastra。

body.en: Oliena/Nepente di Oliena: Oliena and part of Orgosolo.
body.zh: Oliena／Nepente di Oliena：Oliena 及部分 Orgosolo。

body.en: Castiadas, Muravera, San Vito, Villaputzu and Villasimius.
body.zh: Castiadas、Muravera、San Vito、Villaputzu、Villasimius。

body.en: Jerzu and Cardedu.
body.zh: Jerzu 与 Cardedu。

body.en: At least 85%; Classico at least 90%.
body.zh: 至少 85%，Classico 至少 90%。

body.en: Cannonau is the Sardinian name of Garnacha Tinta/Grenache Noir.
body.zh: Cannonau 为 Garnacha Tinta／Grenache Noir 的 Sardegna 名称。

body.en: Red, rosato, Riserva, Classico, Passito and Liquoroso.
body.zh: 红、桃红、Riserva、Classico、风干及加强型。

body.en: Maximum 11 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 11 吨／公顷。

body.en: Maximum 9 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 9 吨／公顷。

body.en: Usually 70%; Passito maximum 55%.
body.zh: 通常 70%，Passito 最高 55%。

body.en: At least two years, including six months in wood.
body.zh: 至少两年，其中六个月木桶。

body.en: At least two years, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 至少两年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: Minimum actual alcohol 18% for Secco, 16% for Dolce; at least six months in wood.
body.zh: Secco 实际酒精至少 18%，Dolce 至少 16%，木桶至少六个月。

coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: Southwestern Sardegna’s Carignano DOC, with specific bush-vine and maturation requirements for Superiore.
intro.zh: Sardegna 西南部 Carignano DOC，Superiore 有具体灌木藤及熟化要求。

body.en: Carignano del Sulcis DOC
body.zh: Carignano del Sulcis DOC

body.en: DOC established in 1977.
body.zh: DOC 建于 1977 年。

body.en: Sulcis in southwestern Sardegna.
body.zh: Sardegna 西南部 Sulcis。

body.en: Carignano is the local name of Carignan.
body.zh: Carignano 为 Carignan 当地名称。

body.en: Carignano at least 85%.
body.zh: Carignano 至少 85%。

body.en: Other suitable black grapes may make up the balance.
body.zh: 余量可用其他获准黑葡萄。

body.en: Rosso, Rosato, Novello, Riserva, Superiore and Passito.
body.zh: 红、桃红、新酒、珍藏、Superiore、风干。

body.en: Up to 11 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 11 吨／公顷。

body.en: Up to 7.5 tonnes/ha.
body.zh: 最高 7.5 吨／公顷。

body.en: Alberello or supported alberello.
body.zh: 灌木式或有支撑灌木式。

body.en: At least two years ageing, including six months in bottle.
body.zh: 至少两年，其中瓶陈至少六个月。

body.en: Natural drying, with permitted partial dehydration by ventilation.
body.zh: 自然风干，可用通风进行部分脱水。

body.en: Maximum 50%.
Minimum total alcohol 13%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精 13%。

body.en: Minimum total alcohol 16%, actual 14%.
body.zh: 最低总酒精 16%，实际 14%。

body.en: Minimum six months, including three months in bottle.
body.zh: 至少六个月，其中瓶陈三个月。

coverage.zh: 收录经核实的代表性品种与产区，不宣称已覆盖大区全部内容。

intro.en: A western Sardinian DOC for mature Vernaccia wines, with flor ageing a defining producer reference.
intro.zh: Sardegna 西部陈年 Vernaccia DOC，酒花膜熟化为重要生产者参照。

body.en: Vernaccia di Oristano DOC
body.zh: Vernaccia di Oristano DOC

body.en: DOC established in 1971, Sardegna’s first.
body.zh: 1971 年建立，为 Sardegna 首个 DOC。

body.en: Oristano and delimited surrounding communes.
body.zh: Oristano 及周边划定市镇。

body.en: Lower Tirso valley and Sinis.
body.zh: Tirso 下游谷地与 Sinis。

body.en: Contini’s source vineyards: alluvial, sandy and slightly clayey.
body.zh: Contini 原料园为冲积、砂质、略带黏土。

body.en: Mild winters, hot ventilated summers and limited rainfall.
body.zh: 冬季温和、夏季炎热通风、降雨有限。

intro.en: Puglia combines Primitivo and Negroamaro country with Uva di Troia in the north and a diverse central white-grape tradition. Its principal names cover distinct legal styles rather than a single warm-climate red-wine model.

body.en: Castel del Monte occupies the Murgia landscape north of Bari.
body.zh: Castel del Monte 位于 Bari 以北的 Murgia 地景。

body.en: Manduria lies in the Taranto–Brindisi denomination; Gioia del Colle is a separate inland denomination.
body.zh: Manduria 酒区涉及 Taranto、Brindisi；Gioia del Colle 为独立内陆酒区。

body.en: Valle d’Itria around Locorotondo and Martina Franca supports local white traditions.

body.en: Limestone and calcarenite dominate the documented Castel del Monte landscape.
body.zh: 所引 Castel del Monte 资料以石灰岩及钙质砂岩为主。

body.en: Karst landforms and fissured rock affect drainage and usable rooting space.
body.zh: 岩溶地貌与岩石裂隙影响排水及根域。

body.en: Castel del Monte geology should not be applied as a uniform soil description to all Puglia.

body.en: The Castel del Monte account describes hot dry summers and cooler inland winters.
body.zh: Castel del Monte 资料描述夏季炎热干燥、内陆冬季较冷。

body.en: Manduria rules permit emergency irrigation while prohibiting forcing.

body.en: Authenticated Pampanuto and Verdeca share the same genotype.

body.en: Historically called Fiano locally, but distinct from Fiano di Avellino; the berries have a muscat-like flavour.

body.zh: Castel del Monte Bombino Nero 须至少 90% Bombino Nero。

body.en: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale is a distinct 100% Primitivo DOCG with at least 50 g/L sugar.
body.zh: Primitivo di Manduria Dolce Naturale 为独立 DOCG，100% Primitivo，糖至少 50 g/L。

body.en: The Primitivo type is 100% Primitivo; the generic Rosso uses a separate blend.
body.zh: Primitivo 酒型为 100% Primitivo；普通 Rosso 使用另一配比。

body.en: The denomination covers red, rosato and white categories; current standard red/rosato requires Negroamaro ≥85%.

body.en: The DOC permits dry to abboccato wine up to 18 g/L sugar; that does not make it Dolce Naturale DOCG.
body.zh: DOC 允许干至微甜、糖最高 18 g/L，不能因此标作 Dolce Naturale DOCG。

body.en: The two red Riserva DOCGs require two years, including one year in wood.
body.zh: 两个红酒 Riserva DOCG 均须两年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: At least 24 months, including nine in wood, from 1 November of the harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少 24 个月，其中木桶九个月。

body.en: Early flowering; harvest normally in the second to third ten-day period of September.
body.zh: 早开花，通常九月中至下旬成熟采收。

body.en: Salice Salentino Superiore has a 9 t/ha limit and excludes pergola/tendone training.
body.zh: Salice Salentino Superiore 最高 9 吨／公顷，不用 pergola／tendone。

body.en: Cirò and Cirò Marina form the Classico DOCG; the broader DOC also includes delimited Melissa and Crucoli land.

body.en: The passito DOC covers Bianco and part of Casignana in the Locride district.
body.zh: 风干 DOC 包括 Locride 的 Bianco 及部分 Casignana。

body.en: Pecorello is associated with Cosenza/Donnici, Marsigliana Nera with Lamezia and Prunesta with Tyrrhenian Reggio.

body.en: Greco Bianco and Mantonico Bianco are different varieties; the local aromatic Greco di Bianco belongs to the Malvasia identity.

body.en: Harvest commonly late September to early October in the ARSAC account.

body.en: The aromatic local Greco di Gerace belongs with the Malvasia di Lipari/Sardegna identity.

intro.en: Sicilia ranges from Etna’s volcanic vineyards and Vittoria’s red blends to western fortified wines and island passiti. Its indigenous grape collection includes both established varieties and recently recovered material.
intro.zh: Sicilia 从 Etna 火山葡萄园、Vittoria 红酒混酿，延伸至西部加强酒及离岛风干酒；本地葡萄既有成熟主流品种，也有近年恢复材料。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Delimitations cover eligible vineyards in 20 Catania communes around the volcano.
body.zh: 火山周围 Catania 省 20 个市镇的合资格园地。

body.en: Cerasuolo di Vittoria spans delimited southeastern areas in Ragusa, Caltanissetta and Catania provinces.
body.zh: Cerasuolo di Vittoria 涉及东南部 Ragusa、Caltanissetta、Catania 三省划定区域。

body.en: The Trapani production area excludes Pantelleria, Favignana and Alcamo.
body.zh: Trapani 生产范围不含 Pantelleria、Favignana、Alcamo。

body.en: DOC in 1973; DOCG in 2005.
body.zh: 1973 年 DOC，2005 年 DOCG。

body.en: Malvasia delle Lipari DOC dates to 1973.
body.zh: Malvasia delle Lipari DOC 始于 1973 年。

body.en: The 2014 regional monograph documents recovered accessions, morphology, genetic relationships and experimental wine assessment.
body.zh: 2014 大区专著记录恢复材料、形态、遗传关系及试验酿酒。

body.en: Volcanic substrates and distinct lava-flow histories contribute to site variation.
body.zh: 火山母质及不同熔岩流历史带来地点差异。

body.en: Castellaro’s Corinto vineyard is on sandy volcanic soils at 350 m.
body.zh: Castellaro 的 Corinto 园为海拔 350 米砂质火山土。

body.en: Volcanic descriptions apply to those sites, not to every Sicilian vineyard.
body.zh: 火山土描述适用于具体地点，并非 Sicilia 每一处园地。

body.en: Carricante leads whites; Nerello Mascalese leads reds, with Nerello Cappuccio an allowed complement.
body.zh: 白酒以 Carricante 为主；红酒以 Nerello Mascalese 为主，可辅 Nerello Cappuccio。

body.en: Nero d’Avola supplies 50–70% and Frappato 30–50% of Cerasuolo di Vittoria.
body.zh: Cerasuolo di Vittoria：Nero d’Avola 50–70%，Frappato 30–50%。

body.en: Zibibbo is Muscat of Alexandria; most categories require 100%, with specific Bianco/Frizzante exceptions.
body.zh: Zibibbo 即 Muscat of Alexandria；多数酒型须 100%，Bianco／Frizzante 有具体例外。

body.en: Bianco requires Carricante ≥60%; Bianco Superiore ≥80% and the Milo area.
body.zh: Bianco 须 Carricante 至少 60%；Bianco Superiore 至少 80% 且限 Milo。

body.en: Bianco and Frizzante can include up to 15% other suitable whites under the 2024 specification.
body.zh: 依 2024 规范，Bianco、Frizzante 可含最多 15% 其他获准白葡萄。

body.en: Published specification: Malvasia up to 95%, Corinto Nero 5–8%.
body.zh: 所引已发布规范：Malvasia 最高 95%，Corinto Nero 5–8%。

body.en: Fine 1 year; Superiore 2; Superiore Riserva 4; Vergine 5; Vergine Riserva 10.
body.zh: Fine 一年、Superiore 两年、Superiore Riserva 四年、Vergine 五年、Vergine Riserva 十年。

body.en: At least four years including one in wood, from 1 November of the harvest year.
body.zh: 自采收年 11 月 1 日起至少四年，其中一年木桶。

body.en: Maximum wine conversion 40%; minimum total alcohol 20%, actual 14%; release from 1 July after harvest.
body.zh: 最高出酒率 40%，最低总酒精 20%、实际 14%，采收后次年 7 月 1 日起上市。

body.en: Oro and Ambra use the specified whites; Rubino uses Perricone, Nero d’Avola and Nerello Mascalese, with up to 30% eligible whites.
body.zh: Oro、Ambra 用规定白葡萄；Rubino 用 Perricone、Nero d’Avola、Nerello Mascalese，可含最多 30% 合资格白葡萄。

body.en: No cooked must, concentrated must or sifone; distinguish its production from other Marsala categories.
body.zh: 不加煮汁、浓缩汁或 sifone，须与其他 Marsala 类别区分。

body.en: Tenuta di Castellaro makes a dry 100% Corinto Nero wine, separate from the sweet Malvasia delle Lipari blend.
body.zh: Tenuta di Castellaro 酿造干型 100% Corinto Nero，与 Malvasia delle Lipari 甜型混酿分开。

body.en: The University of Milan project studies and valorises Sicilian grape biodiversity.
body.zh: Milano 大学 BI.VI.SI 项目研究及发展 Sicilia 葡萄多样性。

body.en: Lucignola and Vitrarolo appear among documented recovered varieties; current regulatory eligibility requires the applicable registration and denomination list.
body.zh: Lucignola、Vitrarolo 属有文献的恢复品种；现行种植使用仍须对照注册及产区清单。

body.en: A 2025 genomic study identifies authenticated Aeolian Corinto Nero as a seedless somatic variant of Sangiovese, distinct from Greek Black Corinth.
body.zh: 2025 基因组研究确认经鉴定 Aeolian Corinto Nero 为 Sangiovese 无籽体细胞变异，与希腊 Black Corinth 不同。

role.zh: Etna 红及起泡主体，亦可用于 Marsala Rubino。

role.en: Cerasuolo di Vittoria blend and Marsala Rubino.

intro.en: Sardegna combines the Vermentino of Gallura, Cannonau across the island, Carignano in Sulcis and long-aged Vernaccia around Oristano. Local synonyms require particular care: Bovale Sardo, Cagnulari and Bovale Grande are not interchangeable labels.
intro.zh: Sardegna 包括 Gallura 的 Vermentino、全岛 Cannonau、Sulcis 的 Carignano 及 Oristano 长期熟化 Vernaccia；Bovale Sardo、Cagnulari、Bovale Grande 不可随意互换。

body.en: Administrative region
body.zh: 行政大区

body.en: Gallura is northeastern Sardegna; Sulcis is southwestern.
body.zh: Gallura 在东北，Sulcis 在西南。

body.en: Oristano’s reference vineyards include the lower Tirso and Sinis.
body.zh: Oristano 代表葡萄园位于 Tirso 下游及 Sinis。

body.en: Mandrolisai includes Atzara, Desulo, Meana Sardo, Ortueri, Samugheo, Sorgono and Tonara.
body.zh: Mandrolisai 包括 Atzara、Desulo、Meana Sardo、Ortueri、Samugheo、Sorgono、Tonara。

body.en: Vernaccia di Oristano 1971, Cannonau di Sardegna 1972, Carignano del Sulcis 1977.
body.zh: Vernaccia di Oristano 1971、Cannonau di Sardegna 1972、Carignano del Sulcis 1977。

body.en: Mandrolisai DOC was recognised in 1981.
body.zh: Mandrolisai DOC 于 1981 年认可。

body.en: Vermentino di Gallura obtained DOCG in 1996.
body.zh: Vermentino di Gallura 于 1996 年获 DOCG。

body.en: The DOCG requires soils from decomposed granite, generally coarse sand with finer components.
body.zh: DOCG 要求源自花岗岩分解的土壤，通常为粗砂夹细粒。

body.en: Eligible DOCG sites do not exceed 500 m.
body.zh: DOCG 合资格园地不超过 500 米。

body.en: Contini describes low-lying alluvial, sandy and slightly clayey soils in its source area.
body.zh: Contini 描述原料地区为低海拔冲积、砂质、略带黏土土壤。

body.en: Authenticated Muristellu/Bovale Sardo is Carcajolo Noir/Parraleta, not Cagnulari.
body.zh: 经鉴定 Muristellu／Bovale Sardo 即 Carcajolo Noir／Parraleta，不是 Cagnulari。

body.en: Cagnulari corresponds to Graciano; Barbera Sarda is a local synonym, not Piemonte Barbera.
body.zh: Cagnulari 对应 Graciano；Barbera Sarda 为地方同义名，并非 Piemonte Barbera。

body.en: Granatza matches Guarnaccia Bianca. Vernaccia di Oristano matches authenticated nationally registered Spergola, not every historical accession with that name.
body.zh: Granatza 对应 Guarnaccia Bianca；Vernaccia di Oristano 对应经鉴定国家注册 Spergola，并非所有历史同名材料。

body.en: Gallura DOCG requires Vermentino at least 95%; it is separate from Vermentino di Sardegna DOC.
body.zh: Gallura DOCG 须 Vermentino 至少 95%，与 Vermentino di Sardegna DOC 分开。

body.en: Standard Cannonau DOC ≥85%; Classico ≥90%, within delimited Nuoro/Ogliastra.
body.zh: 普通 Cannonau DOC 至少 85%；Classico 至少 90%，限划定 Nuoro／Ogliastra。

body.en: Bovale Sardo ≥35%, Cannonau 20–35%, Monica 20–35%.
body.zh: Bovale Sardo 至少 35%，Cannonau 20–35%，Monica 20–35%。

body.en: At least 3,250 vines/ha for new/replanted vineyards; regular yield 10 t/ha, Superiore 9.
body.zh: 新植／重植至少 3,250 株／公顷，普通 10 吨／公顷、Superiore 9 吨。

body.en: Alberello or supported alberello; maximum 7.5 t/ha.
body.zh: 灌木式或有支撑灌木式，最高 7.5 吨／公顷。

body.en: Standard maximum 11 t/ha; Classico 9 t/ha.
body.zh: 普通最高 11 吨／公顷，Classico 9 吨。

body.en: Standard two years in oak/chestnut; Superiore three; Riserva four. Contini Flor illustrates maturation under a yeast veil in partly filled casks.
body.zh: 普通橡木／栗木桶两年，Superiore 三年，Riserva 四年；Contini Flor 为不装满桶内酒花膜熟化实例。

body.en: Riserva two years including six months wood; Classico two years including one year wood.
body.zh: Riserva 两年含六个月木桶；Classico 两年含一年木桶。

body.en: Riserva and Superiore require two years, including six months in bottle.
body.zh: Riserva、Superiore 须两年，其中瓶陈六个月。

body.en: Vernaccia Flor spends about four years under flor; its recommended temperatures vary with aperitif or dessert service.
body.zh: Vernaccia Flor 在酒花膜下约四年，建议温度随开胃或甜点搭配而变。

body.en: Authenticated Sardinian accession research distinguishes local synonyms and preserves rare germplasm.
body.zh: 经鉴定 Sardegna 材料研究用于厘清地方同义名及保留稀有种质。

body.en: Malvasia di Sardegna matches Malvasia di Lipari; island origin does not imply a separate genotype.
body.zh: Malvasia di Sardegna 与 Malvasia di Lipari 同型，来自不同岛屿不表示不同基因型。

role.zh: Cannonau，全岛 DOC 及 Mandrolisai 组分。

evidence.method: Primary genetic studies, official regional conservation records, production specifications and producer technical sheets. Exact legal designations are separate records; uncertain accession identities remain unresolved.

unresolved.reason: Existing canonical giro concerns Alicante. Sardinian Girò must not be merged solely by spelling; authenticated cross-country genotype comparison still required.

2014 Sicilia monograph reports accession-level synonym clusters while newer registration lists distinguish names. Withhold a second canonical identity until authenticated registered profiles are compared.
Names vary by locality; do not universally map them to Bobal, Carignan or Graciano. Cagnulari and Muristellu identity is handled explicitly.
Identity and accession mapping with Greco Bianco require further primary genetic verification before an independent record is added.
A consortium proposal to add dry Bianco/UGA is not treated as enacted law without published final approval.
